description: This file handles embedding UI static files into a Go application, setting up route handlers with the Gin framework to serve embedded UI assets and index.html for SPA routing, and includes a function to check if UI files are embedded.

methods.name: RegisterUIRoutes
methods.description: Registers routes for serving embedded UI files, static assets, and SPA fallback using Gin.

methods.name: IsUIEmbedded
methods.description: Checks if UI files are embedded by attempting to read 'dist/index.html' from the embedded filesystem.
